bio: The location of this restaurant is not only spectacular, but also handy for doing a spot of shopping in the RathausGalerien mall before taking the lift up to the seventh floor for dinner. Here on the top floor, the upscale restaurant has all-round windows and a magnificent view of Innsbruck and the surrounding mountains – in summer, the charm of the terrace is irresistible! In the 360° bar you can drink in the marvellous panoramic view as you enjoy an aperitif, nightcap or coffee. The kitchen serves delicious international and regional dishes. In the evening there are three set menus comprising three to four courses; at lunchtime the à la carte selection is somewhat simpler....
